html:
The Kuungkari are an Aboriginal people of central west Queensland, in country along the Barcoo River near present day Blackall and Tambo. They should not be confused with the Gunggari further south.

Their neighbours on the map include the Bidjara to the east and the Wadjalang to the south. The Barcoo is part of the inland river system that feeds Cooper Creek. Sheep stations spread into the area in the 1860s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
